name: safe-docx
description: AI-native Word (.docx) and OpenDocument (.odt) editing with stable paragraph anchors and deterministic document operations.
long_description:
Safe Docx lets Claude work directly with .docx files on your local filesystem. It provides stable paragraph IDs (_bk_*) for precise editing while preserving formatting and structure.

Core capabilities include reading/searching content, formatting-preserving edits and inserts, deterministic layout controls, tracked-changes output, comments, footnote tools, document comparison, and revision extraction.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read document content with stable paragraph IDs.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search for text patterns in the document.

tools.name: get_document_outline
tools.description: Get a compact structural map of the document's headings with stable paragraph IDs.

tools.name: get_sections
tools.description: Inspect DOCX sections, page setup, header/footer references, and page-number settings.

tools.name: batch_edit
tools.description: Validate, conflict-check, and apply multiple edit steps in one call.

tools.name: replace_text
tools.description: Replace text in a paragraph while preserving formatting.

tools.name: insert_paragraph
tools.description: Insert a new paragraph before or after an anchor paragraph.

tools.name: save
tools.description: Save clean/tracked output document variants to disk.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export a document to a portable Markdown rendering on disk (lossy; DOCX only).

tools.name: convert_to_odt
tools.description: Convert a DOCX document to OpenDocument Text (.odt) on disk (semantic, intentionally lossy; DOCX only).

tools.name: format_layout
tools.description: Apply deterministic paragraph/table layout formatting controls.

tools.name: format_section
tools.description: Partially update a DOCX section's page numbering, page size/orientation, or margins with tracked-change support.

tools.name: insert_section_break
tools.description: Insert a tracked DOCX section break after a stable main-body paragraph.

tools.name: format_numbering
tools.description: Change one DOCX paragraph's direct numbering reference using existing numbering definitions.

tools.name: accept_changes
tools.description: Accept tracked changes in the document body.

tools.name: accept_ai_edits
tools.description: Selectively accept tracked changes by revision id or author, preserving other reviewers' revisions.

tools.name: reject_ai_edits
tools.description: Selectively reject tracked changes by revision id or author, preserving other reviewers' revisions.

tools.name: has_tracked_changes
tools.description: Check whether the current document body contains tracked-change markers.

tools.name: get_file_status
tools.description: Get file/session metadata and status.

tools.name: close_file
tools.description: Close an open file session, or close all sessions.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment or threaded reply.

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: Get all comments with IDs, anchors, authors, dates, and threaded replies.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment and all threaded replies.

tools.name: compare_documents
tools.description: Compare two documents and write a tracked-changes output document.

tools.name: get_footnotes
tools.description: Get all footnotes with IDs, display numbers, text, and anchors.

tools.name: add_footnote
tools.description: Add a footnote anchored to a paragraph.

tools.name: update_footnote
tools.description: Update the text content of an existing footnote.

tools.name: delete_footnote
tools.description: Delete a footnote and its reference from the document.

tools.name: clear_formatting
tools.description: Clear bold and/or highlight formatting from paragraphs.

tools.name: extract_revisions
tools.description: Extract tracked-change revisions as structured JSON.
